security.modes: OBSERVATION_ONLY rejects mutation before adapter calls. CONTROLLED_DISPATCH requires permission/current capability/dedupe/lookup, then hard OPERATION_DISABLED; no real command execution.
security.credentials: Private redacted server map, EXTERNAL_SECRET_* references only; no credential in adapter context or safe view. Known raw/JSON-escaped reflected values rejected.
security.transport: Shared existing providerEndpoint policy; exact origin/admin IP pins; public HTTPS; explicit trusted local exception; every DNS answer validated; pinned connection and verified peer; original-host TLS/SNI; redirects refused; GET-only JSON.
security.resourceBounds: 5-second shared operation/DNS/request budget, 1-second connect budget, 64KiB response, 8KiB headers, 20-item page, independent 4-operation and 4-outbound-call caps. Ignoring abort retains a slot until settlement. No retries/polling loops.
security.authorization: Future server-derived ExternalAccess; same owner and allowed operation checked before adapter invocation. No public management/invocation routes. Tenancy unsupported, not simulated.
security.errorBoundary: Closed normalized codes; raw provider messages/stacks not copied. Retryable is advisory, not mutation retry permission.

integrationEvidence.actualNest: Real application boot + HTTP health without external configuration; custom Nest application context with explicit fixture registration and service health/read; safe init failure for unknown configured adapter.
integrationEvidence.actualTransport: Real pinned loopback HTTP server for GET/auth/redirect/abort; controlled native HTTPS seam tests TLS hostname options, IP pinning, peer verification, framing/status handling; no live public endpoint.
integrationEvidence.database: Existing pinned official PostgreSQL Docker harness owns random isolated database/container/volume and credentials. No developer/production database is targeted.
integrationEvidence.fixturePolicy: All adapter fixture implementations live under apps/api/test, never registered by default production module.
integrationEvidence.ci: Existing verify:phase1 -> test:api/test:db includes new cases automatically. Hosted CI not executed.
integrationEvidence.environment: Supported Node 24 / local Docker Desktop 27.4.0; Docker was stopped, started hidden and readiness checked before database run. No paid or real provider required.

preservation.scope: No existing native runtime/provider/collaboration source, frontend/city source, schema, migration, CI or package changes.

limitations: No production adapter is registered or real provider compatibility proven; provider choice remains open for T08.
No public connection/adapter management APIs; static server profiles only. Connection DB registration/type/FK/mapping checks are T07 prerequisites, not proven by profile configuration.
Production principal/tenant auth is not implemented; existing fixed-owner trusted loopback development/test boundary remains.
Controlled-dispatch is a gated contract only: actual mutations remain OPERATION_DISABLED pending reviewed durable remote intent/dedupe/recovery.
Read-only HTTP JSON/Bearer transport foundation only; no SDK/stdio, OAuth refresh, mTLS or WebSocket integration.
No external identity/Execution persistence, event inbox/consumers/webhooks/subscriptions/checkpoints, projection or UI.
Trusted backend adapters must cooperate with cancellation and use the facade; this is not an untrusted-code sandbox.
Hosted CI, real provider auth, live external discovery/dispatch/cancellation and Mermaid rendering are not claimed.
